pages.text: $(thing)Combination Crafting/$ is a crafting recipe type that uses the $(item)Combination Package Crafter/$ to craft recipes craftable in a $(item)Crafting Core/$.

pages.title: Usage
pages.text: To use the $(item)Combination Package Crafter/$, connect power to the crafter, and place $(item)Marked Pedestals/$ in a 7x7 area around it.$(p)Items crafted by the $(item)Combination Package Crafter/$ will be ejected into adjacent inventories.

pages.title: AE2 Integration
pages.text: The $(item)Combination Package Crafter/$ and $(item)Marked Pedestal/$ can be connected to an $(thing)ME Network/$.$(p)They will instead eject crafted and remaining items into the network.
